rubric.role_summary: Business operations and strategy role partnering primarily with Engineering, Product, and Design leaders on strategic analysis, business cases, quantitative models, and business performance.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Business operations and strategy role partnering primarily with Engineering, Product, and Design leaders on strategic analysis, business cases, quantitative models, and business performance.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of strategy experience, including 2+ years in management consulting or a related field.
- Quantitative and financial modeling skills.
- Working knowledge of SQL.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prior strategy and operations experience in B2B SaaS businesses.
- Experience with pricing and packaging, especially for AI products.
- Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tools such as Notion AI, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar.
- Working knowledge of SQL and ability to access, assess, and synthesize relevant data independently.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
